title: 完本感言
content_zh:
完本了。
心情真的是很复杂，万般的不舍，都不敢看最后一章的书评了。
但是，天下没有不散的宴席，我不是不能写，就出征，刘安治国，卫青这些，其实也能写个百余章出来，但是我觉得，再写下去就有些水文的嫌疑了，我尊重我的正版读者们，不希望最后是以被读者催促着完结的方式来结束的，因此，在我觉得最适合的地方选择了完结，国内形式大好，刘长没有眷恋，对外碾压，身毒的局势也逐步改善，没有什么隐患。
这本书对我的意义重大，我很小就有一个大神梦，是这本书帮我圆了自己的梦想，上一年我经历了很多很多，大起大落，有好的一面，也有不好的一面，但是我们都熬过去了，我很感谢这本书，这本书救下了我，我也很感谢我的读者们，是你们救下了我，如果不是这本书，或许我的生命，我的家庭就停止在上一年了。
非常感谢我所有的读者们，谢谢你们的喜欢，谢谢你们的支持。
感谢上一年所有对我伸出援手的好心人们，感谢你们的帮助，我没齿不忘。
我居然都不知该说些什么了，心情复杂，当初我想写一个温情的故事，写一个不同于别人的故事，现在看来，大概是成功了，得到了这么多兄弟们的喜爱，满满的成就感。738
每一本书，对我来说，都是一个经验的总结，每本书我总是能学到点东西，这本书同样如此，下本书一定吸取经验教训，写的更好
家父这本书，我写了一年多，每天一万字，整整一年多，每天都是沉浸在剧情之中，但是我并不觉得累，我很开心，也很享受的，一天不做点什么就很难受，所以我本来是准备无缝连接的，完结后直接开下一本书，新书的前三章我都写好了。
但是吧，有位读者找到了我，我们的读者里当真是藏龙卧虎，那位读者是個制片人，他想要制作一部关于新疆的综艺，需要一个熟悉新疆，文笔优秀的主编剧，作为目前新疆最为成功的网络作家，咳咳，舍我其谁
我从来没有写过综艺，但是我对这个提议很感兴趣，因为我一直都想为家乡做点事，奈何没有这个能力，如今我可以动笔书写家乡，将家乡宣传出去，让大家都看到不一样的新疆，独特的新疆文化，我还是很开心的。
可惜啊，这写剧本不能抄大家的书评，只能是我自己来写了，这大概需要一个月的时间吧，集数并不多，我写的比较快，对了，我们那个剧组比较穷，是个穷逼剧组，如果有大佬愿意商谈广告冠名或者其他招商合作，我可以帮着联系制片方。
反正就是争取一个月内完成剧本的创作，同时也是准备新书，我听说七月也要开新书了，压力太大，新书得好好准备，免得被他按着一顿揍。
所以可能要在七月底，八月初的时候发新书吧。
还是说起这本书吧，其实还有很多东西我没有写到的，所以我准备了很多的番外，往后可以慢慢去写了，大家想看什么可以给我留言，我都可以去写。
唉，就这么结束了，心里还是很不舍，我要自己再去从头看一遍了。
谢谢大家的陪伴，感谢大家的支持老狼一定再接再厉，努力将下本书写好，写出能让大家更加喜欢的作品。
衷心感谢大家，爱你们番外篇再见
content_en:
Completed.
My emotions are really complicated, and I am so reluctant to let go that I dare not read the review of the last chapter.
However, there is no such thing as a banquet in the world. It’s not that I can’t write about going to war, Liu An governing the country, Wei Qing, etc., I can actually write more than a hundred chapters, but I feel that if I write any more, it will be a bit suspicious. I respect my genuine readers, no I hope it will end in a way that readers are urging me to finish, so I chose to finish it where I think it is most suitable. The domestic situation is good, Liu Chang is not sentimental, he crushes the outside world, and the drug situation is gradually improving, and there are no hidden dangers.
This book means a lot to me. I had a dream of being a great god when I was very young. This book helped me realize my dream. I experienced a lot in the past year, ups and downs, both good and bad, but we all got through it. I am very grateful to this book, which saved me. I am also very grateful to my readers. It was you who saved me. If it were not for this book, maybe my life and my family would have stopped in the last year.
Thank you very much to all my readers, thank you for your likes and thank you for your support.
Thank you to all the kind people who extended a helping hand to me last year. Thank you for your help. I will never forget it.
I actually don’t know what to say, and I feel mixed. At first, I wanted to write a warm story, a story that was different from others. Now it seems that I have succeeded. I have been loved by so many brothers, and I feel a full sense of accomplishment. 738
Every book, to me, is a summary of experience. I can always learn something from every book. The same is true for this book. I will definitely learn from my experience and lessons in the next book and write better.
I wrote the book "Father" for more than a year. I wrote 10,000 words a day for more than a year. I was immersed in the plot every day, but I didn't feel tired. I was very happy and enjoyed it. It would be very uncomfortable if I didn't do something for a day. So I originally planned to seamlessly connect it and start the next book directly after finishing it. I have written the first three chapters of the new book.
But, a reader found me. There are really hidden dragons and crouching tigers among our readers. The reader is a producer. He wants to produce a variety show about Xinjiang. He needs a chief screenwriter who is familiar with Xinjiang and has excellent writing skills. As the most successful online writer in Xinjiang at present, who else can I do?
I have never written a variety show, but I am very interested in this proposal, because I have always wanted to do something for my hometown, but I don’t have the ability. Now I can write about my hometown and promote my hometown, so that everyone can see a different Xinjiang and the unique Xinjiang culture. I am still very happy.
It's a pity that I can't copy everyone's book reviews when writing the script. I have to write it myself. It takes about a month. There are not many episodes, so I wrote it relatively quickly. By the way, our crew is relatively poor and a poor crew. If there are big bosses who are willing to negotiate advertising sponsorship or other investment cooperation, I can help contact the producer.
Anyway, I am trying to finish writing the script within a month, and I am also preparing for a new book. I heard that a new book will be published in July. There is too much pressure. I have to prepare the new book well to avoid being beaten by him.
So the new book will probably be released at the end of July or the beginning of August.
Let’s talk about this book. In fact, there are still many things that I haven’t written, so I have prepared a lot of extras, which I can write slowly in the future. If you want to read anything, you can leave me a message and I can write it.
Alas, it ended like this, and I still feel very sad. I want to watch it again from the beginning.
Thank you for your company and your support. I will continue to work hard to write the next book and write a work that everyone will like more.
Thank you all from the bottom of my heart. I love you and see you in the extra chapter.
